socialPromo.headline: My Farhan Deals Journey
socialPromo.subhead: From teenage dreams to real-world online business struggles.
socialPromo.scene: A young man, Farhan Balouch (18-20 years old, South Asian appearance), sits in a dimly lit room, late at night. He is intensely focused on a laptop screen, which displays a Shopify dashboard or a dropshipping product page. Scattered around him are open notebooks, a half-empty tea glass, and perhaps a mobile phone displaying social media reels. The room has a humble, authentic feel, perhaps a typical Pakistani home setting. The lighting is warm but focused on his face and the screen, highlighting his determination and the solitary nature of his work. The mood is one of quiet perseverance and ambition.
socialPromo.caption: Farhan Deals mera sabse bara project hai, lekin is tak pahunchna aasan nahi tha. Bank account se lekar Shopify fees tak, har kadam par mushkilein aayi. Meri kahani padhiye!
